note: The Barrow Stalker's frost bow, tier III (Graveborn), hand-authored at 1 texel a px on the order bow's geometry: pale grave-wood limbs with a frost-grey rimed back, a black grave-iron riser and nocks capped in rime, a violet-wound grip and knee bindings, a rime shard hanging from the riser. Drawn through the same four frames as the order bow. Tier III: risers, nocks and grip thread chased in funeral gilt, gilt knee bands and the bone shard.
